tools.name: recommend_route
tools.description: Recommend a UK running route that fits the runner. Use this when a user describes who they are and what they want — e.g. 'I'm a trail runner near Ambleside, 15k, avoid roads, something scenic and not too technical'. Returns a ranked shortlist with reasoning-friendly fields (surface, ascent, course s

tools.name: search_routes
tools.description: Search Skamper's curated UK running-route database when the user gives concrete filters — name, location (lat/lng), distance range, max ascent, paved surface %, course shape, or national park. Returns up to 20 compact route summaries with canonical URLs. If the user instead describes who they are or

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Fetch the full details for a single Skamper route by its slug. Returns title, location, distance, ascent, surface, course shape, description, reviews, and the canonical page URL. A free Skamper account is required to download the GPX file from the page.

tools.name: find_5k
tools.description: Find Skamper running routes close to 5 km (parkrun distance) near a location. Returns the nearest routes between 4.5 and 5.5 km. Great for runners asking 'a 5k near me'.

tools.name: list_national_parks
tools.description: List the UK National Parks Skamper covers, with route counts and slugs. Use the slug with routes_in_national_park or search_routes (national_park=...).

tools.name: routes_in_national_park
tools.description: List running routes inside a UK National Park. Pass the park slug (use list_national_parks to discover slugs).

tools.name: browse_runlists
tools.description: Browse Skamper run lists — curated collections of routes (e.g. 'Best UK trail half-marathons'). Returns Skamper's editorial picks and the most recent public user-created lists. Use get_runlist to see the routes inside one.

tools.name: get_runlist
tools.description: Fetch a Skamper run list by slug. Returns the list metadata and the ordered routes inside.
